technique_name: Create a timeline of the history of computer vision.
description: The timeline of the history of computer vision starts with the first commercial use of computer vision in 1971, where images were analyzed in order to identify similarities between the images. This was followed by the development of the first computer vision workstations in 1972 and the pioneering works in object recognition and tracking in the late 1970s and early 1980s. In the late 1980s, early neural networks were used in computer vision tasks such as image classification, object recognition
